title: Shaar Hayichud audio class catalog (v1)
description: Generated from data/classes.txt. Sections form a tree (level 1 = '#', 2 = '##', 3 = '###'); lectures are leaves. All ids are stable: clients may persist them (favorites, recents, downloads).

cdnBase.description: Origin every lecture url is built from (no trailing slash).

id.description: Stable id from the ':N' suffix of the heading line. Unique across all sections.

displayOrder.description: 0-based position among its siblings (sections and lectures share one sequence).

lectureCount.description: Number of lectures in this section, including nested sections.

items.description: Child sections and lectures, in display order.

id.description: Stable lecture id. Defaults to the filename; an '@ id' line in classes.txt overrides it. Unique across the catalog.

title.description: From the preceding '- title' line, otherwise 'Part N' (N = 1-based position among the lectures of its parent section).

durationSeconds.description: Length in seconds, or null when not yet measured.

folder.description: CDN folder (unencoded, may contain '/'), from the most recent '>' line.

url.description: Canonical, fully built and percent-encoded URL: cdnBase + each folder segment and the filename encoded with encodeURIComponent, joined by '/'. Use this as-is.
